name: Mimos
long_description:
Plaintiff-side law firms compete in some of the most expensive search ad markets to acquire high-intent leads, but the path from click, call, or form fill to signed retainer is still fragmented. Disconnected intake workflows, slow response times, and disconnected spend-to-case data makes it hard to know what is actually working.

Mimos automates their growth and intake playbook:
1. Generate Qualified Leads: Our agents manage Google Ads, Local Services Ads, Google Business Profile, and other high-intent acquisition channels.
2. Convert Faster: Every lead flows into a CRM built for intake, triage, follow-up, and handoff from inquiry to signed retainer.
3. Close the Loop: We connect spend, lead source, intake actions, and signed-case outcomes so firms know what to scale, pause, or fix.

The result: more qualified leads, less wasted spend, and more signed cases.
one_liner: The growth OS for plaintiff-side law firms

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Rohit is the Co-Founder and CEO of Mimos. 

At Microsoft, he led the architecture of Azure's high-throughput storage infrastructure, working with OpenAI to support their training workloads for GPT-series and Sora models. In high school, he was a competitive Junior Golf Captain (3x League Champion, 7x Top-10 in State).

At Mimos, he is connecting acquisition, intake, follow-up, and attribution so plaintiff-side firms convert leads into signed cases in a fraction of the time.

launches.title: Mimos - Answer Engine Optimization for regulated companies
launches.tagline: With compliance at our core, we help you rank in AI search
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We’re Rohit and Michael, co-founders of Mimos. We’ve been building together since sixth grade—everything from mobile apps to algorithmic trading systems—and now we’re turning compliance into an advantage in the age of AI.

https://youtu.be/McIKklZ0xHI

**The Problem:**

AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini) are replacing Google for high-value questions on health, wealth, and legal. Whoever they cite becomes the voice customers trust.

Regulated firms should dominate this shift — they already have **compliance** as verifiable proof of authority. But that advantage is trapped behind a unique structural dynamic:

* **Marketing** needs to move quickly to publish relevant, expert answers.
* **Compliance** must carefully review every word to ensure regulatory safety.

This friction results in a drawn out publishing cycle, resulting in missed opportunity to rank in AI search.

**Our Solution:**

Mimos makes it easy for regulated firms to get cited in AI answers by streamlining the path from insight to compliant content.

* **Define your audience** — Capture your brand expertise and ICPs to guide tone, examples, and disclosures.
* **Find the right questions** — Track the exact high-intent prompts your prospects ask AI using trend and citation data.
* **See where you stand** — Monitor visibility by engine, track competitor citations, and measure share of voice.
* **Act on opportunities** — Get prioritized recommendations for content, SEO, and distribution.
* **Create faster** — Generate first drafts aligned to your brand and compliance needs.
* **Speed up review** — Package answers with disclosures and claim checks so compliance can approve faster.

**Result:** Insight → content → review → AI visibility — in minutes, not weeks. 

**Our Traction:**

* Signed **5 paying customers** across finance, proptech, and wealth management within one month of launch.
* Building an **active pipeline** in health, investing, proptech, and marketing.
* Early usage already delivering **2× higher AI citation rates** compared to baseline content.

**Our Team:**

* **Michael (Co-Founder & CTO)** — Led the launch and integration of AI into Amazon Alexa devices, architected petabyte-scale data infrastructure at Coinbase, and built consumer websites/mobile apps reaching thousands of users. Brings deep expertise in AI, large-scale infrastructure, and online trust.
* **Rohit (Co-Founder & CEO)** — Designed Azure’s high-throughput storage and auto-scaling infrastructure, working with OpenAI to support their training workloads. Brings experience in building and scaling complex cloud systems for high-demand, mission-critical applications.

Together, our backgrounds in high-performance infrastructure and AI underpin Mimos’s mission: helping regulated firms attract clients by enhancing their online visibility in the age of AI.

**Our Ask:**

Warm intros to Chief Marketing/Growth Officers or fractional CMOs at:

* **Finance** (esp. wealth managers managing $300M+ AUM)
* **Pharma / Biotech**
* **Legal**
* **Telehealth**

An email to [rohit@mimos-ai.com](mailto:rohit@mimos-ai.com) would be greatly appreciated!
